hypothesis: The QfO loss from broader CPM 0.08 candidates may partly arise from changed inferred species-tree context rather than the broader candidates alone.
design: Retain the completed QfO broader_direct candidate partition, satellite constraints, raw gene trees, aligner, tree builder, species_overlap rooting rule, positive_paralogy pair rule, and high_confidence_pair satellite policy. Change only the supplied species-tree input after establishing supplied-own-tree control equivalence.

arms.label: broader_own_tree
arms.gate: Exact RootHOG, native pair and confidence products reproduce broader_direct; supplied rooted topology is preserved; all reconciled raw gene trees hit their checkpoints.

arms.label: broader_baseline_tree
arms.gate: Run only after successful own-tree native equivalence. All other inputs and flags remain identical.

evaluation.interpretation: Compare the held-tree arm with the reproduced own-tree control and retained CPM 0.1 control separately. This diagnoses species-tree handoff conditional on fixed broader candidates; it does not prove an independent anchor-inference method will improve other datasets. No parameter search or defaults promotion in this diagnostic.
evaluation.scoring: Validate native output and frozen input/source hashes before scoring; independently read back all six native assessments. Own-tree control must reproduce deterministic VGNC, SwissTrees, TreeFam-A, EC and GO endpoints; FAS is unseeded and reported descriptively, not required to match exactly.

stop_rules: If supplied-own-tree control equivalence, gene coverage, checkpoint reuse, runtime/source/input pins, or deterministic control scoring fail, preserve the failure and do not evaluate the held-tree variant. Do not silently relax gates or rerun into an existing namespace.
limitations: Species-tree substitution changes the complete tree, including branch lengths and rooting context; topology difference alone does not identify the causal feature.
Functional similarity is not orthology accuracy; FAS is stochastic.
Cached reconciliation and shared-host timings are not fresh full-pipeline or isolated timing measurements.
This is a bounded follow-up to completed membership cells, not a duplicate of ongoing full-search or satellite-policy experiments.
git: Commit and push this plan and tested runner before evaluation; freeze the execution source; retain successful and failed cases and push verified milestones.
